captions.detailed: A utility blimp featuring a large, streamlined grey envelope with a pointed nose and tapered tail. Below the central hull hangs a dark grey gondola supported by thin struts, equipped with a small undercarriage landing wheel. Twin dark engine pods with multi-blade propellers are mounted on the sides of the hull, while a bright orange boxy cruciform tail assembly is attached to the rear. The propellers, rudder, elevators, and landing wheel are designed to rotate on their respective axes.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a utility blimp with a grey streamlined envelope, a dark grey suspended gondola with a landing wheel, twin lateral engine pods with rotating propellers, and an orange cruciform tail unit with moveable control surfaces.
captions.factory: The code constructs the blimp envelope by revolving a custom 2D spline profile around its central axis. The gondola is built from a modified box primitive suspended by cylinder-based struts, while the landing gear uses a cylinder for the wheel. The engine pods and propellers are modeled using cylinders and thin box blades, positioned symmetrically via coordinate offsets. The boxy tail fins are constructed from intersecting box extrusions, with separate rotatable rudder and elevator components attached using revolute joint definitions.
